messages.name: anything
messages.description: Any Max message received in any but the leftmost inlet will be sent to all outlets that are connected to that inlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: received in any but the leftmost inlet will be sent to all outlets that are connected to that inlet.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Clears the state of the switching matrix, All inlets are disconnected from all outlets.

messages.name: connect
messages.digest: Connect an inlet to an outlet
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers that specify inlet and outlet numbers, connects an inlet to an outlet. Multiple inlets can be connected to multiple outlets, and vice versa.

messages.name: disconnect
messages.digest: Disconnect an inlet from an outlet
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers that specify inlet and outlet numbers, disconnects an inlet from an outlet.

messages.name: dump
messages.description: Sends the state of the object's switching matrix out the right outlet as a series of single line lists in the form.

messages.name: float
messages.description: floating-point number received in any but the leftmost inlet will be sent to all outlets that are connected to that inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: An integer received in any but the leftmost inlet will be sent to all outlets that are connected to that inlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: A list of three numbers received in the left inlet is interpreted as specifying an inlet number, an outlet number, and a 0 or 1 specifying the state of a connection. A list in this form changes the inlet and outlet connections of theobject.A list received in any other inlet will be sent to all outlets that are connected to that inlet.

messages.name: patch
messages.digest: Exclusively connect an inlet to an outlet
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers that specify inlet and outlet numbers, connects an inlet to an outlet and disconnects all other inlets that are currently connected to that outlet

messages.name: print
messages.digest: Report matrix state to the Max Console
messages.description: Prints the state of the switching matrix in the Max Console.
